name: Bone Thugs-n-Harmony
notes: ⛔ **The tempo is the model.** The research is emphatic that 72–101 with a 74–86 centre is *slower than the section's documented 90–100 norm and that the gap is the whole point* — the vocal stack needs the space — so this is by far the lowest `bpm` band in the batch and the one number that must not be normalised toward the genre. ⚠ Catalogue readings at 128–156 are doubled readings of the same records and the research marks that `[LOW-CONF]` **as a class**; the band authored here is the halved one. ⛔ **The second rule is register vacation**: the instrumental voicings are documented as vacating the register the voices occupy, so `melody.register` starts at 79 — the highest floor in this batch — `chords.voicing.register` tops out at 67, the lowest ceiling here, and `melody.densityPerBar` and `countermelody.densityRatio` are both held down so the layers do not collide with a 3–5 voice chorale. Harmony is held deliberately still against moving voices: static `i` and `i–VI–VII` at 2 and 4 bars, with `emptyBarBias` the highest of any entry. B minor, C minor and B♭ minor are named poles and are authored as the key set. "Electronic gunshots" and "warped-out dub sounds" used as percussion events rather than effects are the `impact` and `perc2` lanes — the research's own framing is that they are triggered like a drum, which is exactly what a perc lane is. ⚠ `medium` on the research's high-medium, and it names its own inferences: the close-harmony intervals (parallel thirds and sixths with occasional open fifths) are `[LOW-CONF]`, and the tempo *notation* is inferred. Nothing here models the vocal stack — the chopper subdivision, the unison doubling and the 2-and-4-bar member handoffs are the entry's real parameters and there is no vocal generator; the piano `timbreHint` stands in for Mellotron and synthesized strings, which the dataset's timbre vocabulary cannot name. ⚠ The single-chord family was weighted 5 and dominated the model, which held the chord part to 400 distinct harmonies against a floor of 500. It is now weighted 2 behind four real progressions — which is the right reading anyway: this group harmonises OVER Cleveland minor changes, so a static drone was never the description. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 913 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 937/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980**, so its style pool was opened: answer_lick, bell_echo, densityRatio 0.55. ⛔ `counter.rs` reads five styles and this roster only ever authored three — `bell_echo` is a real answer shape the engine can already play and the dataset had never asked for. ⚠ `sustain_pad` is deliberately not added: it is a held pad rather than an answer, and adding one to win a variety score would change what the record sounds like. ⚠ **The melody floor was raised from [1,4] to [2,6] because the COUNTERMELODY was saturating at 943/1000 against a floor of 980.** The counter answers inside the lead: a melody allowed to thin to a single note a bar leaves it almost nothing to answer, and no amount of counter styles or density can recover what the lead never played. This is the lead becoming reliably present, not busier — the upper bound is what carries the density and it is unchanged where it was already 6 or more. ⚠ **`melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.28 to 0.1, and this is the parameter that was actually saturating the countermelody** (this model reached 943/1000 against a floor of 980). An empty bar produces an empty counter region, and every empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one — so silence is the one thing a seed cannot vary. Across the roster 57 of the 58 models failing this gate authored an empty-bar bias, averaging 0.246, against 0.115 for the models that passed. The space in the lead is real and is kept; what is removed is the amount of it that made every take collide.
